About

I'm a law graduate and virtual assistant with two years of hands-on experience supporting tech agencies, executives, and founders across operations, lead generation, content, communications, and client management.

I work best with busy people who need systems. My job is to make your workflow seamless.

Because of my legal training, I handle documents and sensitive information with accuracy and discretion, which gives my clients the confidence that their work is in safe hands.

Whether it's clearing an inbox, running a content calendar, or tracking a budget down to the last naira — I handle the details so you can focus on the work that matters.

Based in Lagos, Nigeria. Available remotely worldwide.
